payload.summary: Tapped "navigate" under Browser tools. The Selected panel now shows the "navigate" Browser tool with a url argument, a Run button, and its input schema.

endAnchors.text: Open a URL on the page's own origin, or a path relative to the current page. The result's changes_before lists what changed on the page since you last received it, before this action; changes lists what the action changed, anything that changed while the page settled after it included.
"The URL to open: a path relative to the current page, or a URL on the page's own origin."

goneAnchors.text: Generate Playwright locators for elements, to write into Page Object Model code; does not act on the page. Structural Refs are capture-scoped: use them in tool calls, never in code. The locators are what belongs in a page object. Group targets by the container they belong to: a group's locators are…
One group per page object class. Leave the container empty for the page, or set it to a component's root: its locators are relative to it.

goneAnchors.name: Pick an element on the page
